_note: The pages of the resident app: the one list of them. The app makes one <Route> for each entry (components/app/app_routes.tsx), and the server answers 200 for an address that matches an entry and 404 for every other address (lib/app_pages.rb, ADR 0016).

To add a page, add an entry here with its pattern and at least one example address. Nothing else is needed: the tests open every example in a browser and check that the server and React Router agree on every path.

A pattern uses React Router's syntax: a static part (calendar), :name for a part that can be anything, and a ? after either one for a part that may be left out. A * (the rest of the path) is refused, because it would make every address under it a page.
